subject: Prompt inventory sync + hands-on workshop — aligning stakeholders & windows
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Katie Sanders <katie@lumahealth.com>, Devin Ortiz <devin@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt inventory sync + hands-on workshop — aligning stakeholders & windows

Hi Katie / Devin —

Quick follow-up from our discovery call last week. We'd like to run a 2-hour hands-on prompt review + routing/load-test session to:
- walk through your prompt inventory (attached stub)
- define structured-output schemas and guardrails
- run a small traffic spike/load window to validate routing and caching behavior

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2026-10-05 09:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-10-06 13:00–15:00

Could you confirm which option works better and who from the Luma ML/infra team will attend? For the load test we'll need a short pre-setup (VPC peering / IP allowlist) — see the runbook stub attached.

Attachments: prompt_inventory_v1.csv (prompt names, sample inputs) | workshop_runbook_stub.md (ops checklist)

If neither time works, flag alternatives and we can pivot.

Thanks — looking forward to making this practical and low-friction.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Katie Sanders <katie@lumahealth.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt inventory sync + hands-on workshop — aligning stakeholders & windows

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — both options look plausible on paper, but our ML lead has a late-afternoon recurring sprint review. Would you be open to shortening to 90 minutes and moving the second option to 14:00–15:30 PT on 2026-10-06? That gives us time for the structured-output decisions and a targeted load window (20–30 minutes) rather than a full 2-hour spike.

Also: for the load test we will need a VPC allowlist and a contact from your infra team to validate routes. I can loop in our infra engineer (ml-team@lumahealth.com) if that's helpful.

Cc'ing Devin — Devin, can you make 10/06 14:00–15:30? If yes, we'll confirm attendees.

Best,
Katie
Head of ML Integrations
Luma Health

Subject: Re: Prompt inventory sync + hands-on workshop — aligning stakeholders & windows

Thanks Katie — 90 minutes works on our side. 2026-10-06 14:00–15:30 PT is fine. We'll shape the agenda to a tight timebox: 14:00–14:15 intro & success criteria; 14:15–14:50 prompt inventory walkthrough + structured-output decisions; 14:50–15:20 load-test window (small burst); 15:20–15:30 action items/next steps.

Rishi, Monica: can you own the runbook steps for the allowlist + short pre-call to validate the VPC peering? Katie — please share the infra contact and any allowlist constraints.

Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(On behalf of the ops team)

Hi all —

14:00–15:30 on 10/06 works for me. I'll include our ML engineer (benji@lumahealth.com) on the invite. Benji will need a short pre-call with Rishi or Monica to confirm network steps; how about a 20-minute sync on 10/05 at 10:00 PT? If that helps reduce friction, we can also send a minimal allowlist (CIDR or IPs) ahead of time.

Also: can you confirm whether the load test will use a sandbox model variant or live traffic routing? We prefer to run against a sandboxed model to avoid production side effects.

Thanks — Devin

Perfect — thank you. Final confirmations below and I've updated the calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-luma-hs-workshop

Final details: 2026-10-06 14:00–15:30 PT (90 minutes)
Attendees (confirmed): Hannah Schmitt (Redwood), Marcus Lin (Redwood), Monica Patel (Redwood), Rishi Malhotra (Redwood), Katie Sanders (Luma), Devin Ortiz (Luma), Benji (Luma ML)
Pre-call for infra allowlist: 2026-10-05 10:00–10:20 PT — Rishi/Monica + Benji (we'll send dial-in separately)
Load test: 10/06 15:00–15:20 PT — sandbox model variant (NO production routing). We'll run a controlled burst (approx 50 rps sustained for 5 minutes) to validate batching and KV cache warmup.

Attachments updated: prompt_inventory_v1.csv (finalized columns) | workshop_runbook_stub.md (with the allowlist checklist) — link to Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PromptInventoryStub

Action items before pre-call:
- Katie: share infra allowlist (CIDR/IPs) and any firewall windows
- Benji: confirm sandbox model name and credentials if needed
- Rishi/Monica: validate we can originate test IPs from our test pool and share the short pre-call dial-in

We'll record the session and follow up with a one-page outcomes doc and recommended quantization/batching settings for your traffic pattern. If anything changes, flag it here or update the calendar.

Thanks everyone — excited to get hands-on.

— Hannah
